reviews.title: XMP works for 2 sticks but if you go with 4, it will have to be slowed down
reviews.comment: Good memory, glad they are in stock and the low profile no extra led lights etc is a plus for me.  I have a noctua air cooler and clearances were something I wanted to make sure I wasn't dealing with. I bought 2 sets of the 5200 speed for 4 sticks.  By doing this the XMP mode would just go into a loop boot.  If I went "auto" in bios it was defaulting to 4000 speed.  I was able to work it up to 4800 speed, I may try getting closer to 5200 but right now I prefer stability over crashes.  I'm on a Z690 prime asus board with the 19-12900k cpu.  My last PC lasted me nearly 10 years so I'm hoping this will keep me future proof for another 10.
